name: gecko
description: A GameCube and Wii emulator sporting an advanced debugger and Lua scripting with optional support for web browsers.

name: ayyboy advance
description: A GameBoy Advance emulator with a very advanced CPU and GPU debugger as well as Rhai scripting support.

name: pspsps
description: An experimental PlayStation 1 emulator and debugger, with basic shader support.

name: ayyboy
description: A classic GameBoy (DMG) and GameBoy Color (GBC) emulator including a basic debugger.

name: gg
description: A GameGear and partial Sega Master System emulator with a built-in debugger.

name: ceload
description: A Bring Your Own Vulnerable Driver tool that allows you to load dbk64.sys and access a plethora of privileged functions.

name: idacode
description: An integration for HexRay's IDA and VS Code which connects both to easily execute and debug IDAPython scripts.

name: SilentLoad
description: Loads a driver through NtLoadDriver by setting up the service registry key directly. To be used in engagement for BYOVD, where service creation creates an alert.
